system.description: At first this seems like a cheap, plastic hair clip of the kind found in most convenience stores, but closer inspection reveals a tiny rune carved into the grip. This cursed item contains a version of the afflict incantation seed that causes the person wearing it to suffer a –4 morale penalty on all saving throws, @Check[ability:cha]{Charisma check}s, and Charisma-based skill checks. Removing the hair clip requires a remove curse or break enchantment spell.

modern20.purchaseDC: 39 (often sold as a mundane hair clip, purchase DC 1)
